items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Freddie Keppard took lessons from R.C. Bia on the trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's still here. I know him quite well. Well, yeah. I never did get to meet his brother. I have some of his records, Freddie's records. Never met Louis? Oh, Louis, I know. But not Freddie. Freddie died before I got...

Well, Freddie went to Chicago, looking book 1910. He went to Chicago 1910. Him and my impressed never could get along together. So when I went... Do you know where he took lessons or what he did? With R.C. Bia. That's all I can tell you. R.C. Bia. Freddie Keppard took lessons from R.C. Bia on the trumpet. Now the violin, I couldn't tell you who taught him because I wouldn't know anything about that. But the trumpet, he took lessons from R.C. Bia on the... He was a top trumpet player too. Always could read the…
He was up there before then.
